definitions.gloss: lacking common sense; outrageous; beyond what is considered normal
definitions.explanation: Describes behavior, actions, or ideas that deviate from what society considers reasonable or normal. Almost always used critically.

examples.japanese: ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{常識外|じょうしきはず}れだ。
{常識外|じょうしきはず}れな⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{周囲|しゅうい}→周囲：03206_shuui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{呆|あき}れた→呆れる：06720_akireru⟧。
examples.english: Everyone around was appalled by the outrageous behavior.

examples.japanese: ⟦{深夜|しんや}→深夜：00368_shinya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大音量|だいおんりょう}→大音量：20540_daionryou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{常識外|じょうしきはず}れ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{甚|はなは}だしい→甚だしい：13520_hanahadashii⟧。
examples.english: Playing music at full volume in the middle of the night is an outrageous lack of common sense.

notes:
USAGE:
{常識外|じょうしきはず}れ is a compound of ⟦{常識|じょうしき}→常識：03287_joushiki⟧ (common sense) and ⟦{外|はず}れ→外れる：02395_hazureru⟧ (deviation, miss). It is used critically to describe actions or people who violate social norms.

COMMON PATTERNS:
Used both as a noun and as a na-adjective modifier:
- {常識外|じょうしきはず}れだ (That's outrageous — predicative)
- {常識外|じょうしきはず}れな⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧ (outrageous behavior — attributive)
- {常識外|じょうしきはず}れ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (a person who lacks common sense — ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧-modification)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{非常識|ひじょうしき}→非常識：14615_hijoushiki⟧ (lacking common sense — similar meaning, more common)
- ⟦{型破|かたやぶ}り→型破り：20262_katayaburi⟧ (unconventional — can be positive)
- {常軌|じょうき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{逸|いっ}する (to deviate from the norm — formal)
